scope: Continues the merged forced-address accounting route (PR #66 PROP-P3-FORCED-ADDRESS-ACCOUNTING-01 at 0bdf9df). Two new proposals: PROP-P3-FORCED-ADDRESS-AUDIT-01, the evaluated per-ADDRESS form of the rule (unit = one address after aggregation of all contributions; mutually exclusive states with precedence ISOTROPIC_TARGET > ACTIVE > EXACT_CANCELLED > NULL_BY_GEOMETRY > TED > FORGOTTEN_REGISTERED / FORGOTTEN_INSIDE => INVALID CLOSURE TEST; exact decisions only on exact inputs; a separate NUMERICAL_ZERO(eps) state on float inputs that is never renamed EXACT; boxed invariant: for every address outside the populated set, F(a) = 0 or a enters the ledger), and PROP-P3-ISOTROPIC-SATURATION-INVARIANT-01 (every denominator-cleared symbolic closure test saturates every symbolic pair sum by u_t (t.t) - 1 = 0, or asserts t.t != 0; the numeric form is the ISOTROPIC_TARGET precedence; origin: the isotropic-artifact retraction R1 of PR #66). Evidence, all finite_diagnostic: W1 / W2 / W3 point A are INVALID with 10 / 12 / 18 FORGOTTEN_INSIDE addresses (calibration on open seeds against the internal record); a fixed-index subset of 20 of the 610 NPSC box-2 SELF_CLOSED_PRODUCTIVE hits, reconstructed with the sweep's own perp_basis copied verbatim, is INVALID with exactly 2 FORGOTTEN_REGISTERED addresses each (the 610/610 result is quoted as an internal record, not re-run; box-1 hits not re-audited); a pre-threshold audit of the T0-02 runtime record (point A, depth 2, five samples from a compact committed export, float semantics declared, no rational rounding in any decision) finds FORGOTTEN_REGISTERED = 0 at every t > 0 sample, 23 forced-and-empty generation-1 addresses at t = 0 (the datum's own first-step targets), and 187 sub-threshold addresses at t = 0.003 that the retention-threshold reader would call not energised although the pipeline carries them (reader artefact, not an accounting omission). Process lesson recorded: point coordinates are basis-dependent; a first internal pass with a different basis of m-perp reported 10 spurious valid hits (log not retained). Claim boundary: depth 1, box-2 hits only, T0-02 d = 2 point A only; the instrument proves nothing about OCSR / Witness Soundness / G6/G7 / Clay Navier-Stokes regularity; no cancellation label is promoted to physical loss; no prior statement is refuted; no global P2 claim is promoted.
